choose.when: INSERT INTO ai_code_chunk (id, document_id, chunk_type, symbol_name, business_summary, source_snippet, embedding_vec, metadata, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{chunkType}, #{symbolName}, #{businessSummary}, #{sourceSnippet}, CAST(#{embeddingVector} AS vector), CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{createdAt})
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO ai_code_chunk (id, document_id, chunk_type, symbol_name, business_summary, source_snippet, metadata, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{chunkType}, #{symbolName}, #{businessSummary}, #{sourceSnippet}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{createdAt})

mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS source_chunk_id, t.id AS target_chunk_id, 'CALL' AS relation_type FROM ai_code_chunk s JOIN ai_code_document sd ON sd.id = s.document_id JOIN ai_code_chunk sf ON sf.document_id = s.document_id AND sf.chunk_type = 'FILE' JOIN ai_code_chunk t ON t.id != s.id JOIN ai_code_document td ON td.id = t.document_id AND td.project_id = sd.project_id WHERE sd.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.chunk_type IN ('METHOD', 'FUNCTION', 'MAPPER') AND t.chunk_type IN ('METHOD', 'FUNCTION', 'MAPPER') AND t.symbol_name IS NOT NULL AND length(t.symbol_name) >= 3 AND COALESCE(s.source_snippet, sf.source_snippet) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.source_snippet, sf.source_snippet) ILIKE '%' || t.symbol_name || '%' AND (lower(td.path) LIKE '%service%' OR lower(td.path) LIKE '%mapper%' OR t.chunk_type = 'MAPPER') UNION ALL SELECT s.id AS source_chunk_id, t.id AS target_chunk_id, 'TABLE' AS relation_type FROM ai_code_chunk s JOIN ai_code_document sd ON sd.id = s.document_id JOIN ai_code_chunk t ON t.id != s.id JOIN ai_code_document td ON td.id = t.document_id AND td.project_id = sd.project_id WHERE sd.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.chunk_type IN ('MAPPER', 'SQL') AND t.chunk_type = 'TABLE' AND t.symbol_name IS NOT NULL AND length(t.symbol_name) >= 2 AND s.source_snippet IS NOT NULL AND s.source_snippet ILIKE '%' || t.symbol_name || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_code_relation (id, project_id, source_chunk_id, target_chunk_id, relation_type) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{sourceChunkId}, #{targetChunkId}, #{relationType}) ON CONFLICT (source_chunk_id, target_chunk_id, relation_type) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.document_id, d.project_id, d.path, d.language, c.chunk_type, c.symbol_name, c.business_summary, c.source_snippet, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'startLine')::int, 0) AS start_line, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'endLine')::int, 0) AS end_line, 0 AS score FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.chunk_type != 'FILE' AND c.document_id IN #{did} ORDER BY d.path ASC, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'startLine')::int, 0) ASC, c.id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE graph AS ( SELECT r.source_chunk_id, r.target_chunk_id, r.relation_type, 1 AS depth, ARRAY[r.source_chunk_id, r.target_chunk_id] AS visited FROM ai_code_relation r WHERE r.source_chunk_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT g.source_chunk_id, r.target_chunk_id, r.relation_type, g.depth + 1, g.visited || r.target_chunk_id FROM graph g JOIN ai_code_relation r ON r.source_chunk_id = g.target_chunk_id WHERE g.depth < #{maxDepth} AND NOT (r.target_chunk_id = ANY(g.visited)) ), ranked AS ( SELECT target_chunk_id, relation_type, depth, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY target_chunk_id ORDER BY depth, relation_type) AS rn FROM graph ) SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.document_id, d.project_id, d.path, d.language, c.chunk_type, c.symbol_name, c.business_summary, c.source_snippet, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'startLine')::int, 0) AS start_line, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'endLine')::int, 0) AS end_line, 0 AS score, ranked.depth AS relation_depth, ranked.relation_type FROM ranked JOIN ai_code_chunk c ON c.id = ranked.target_chunk_id JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ORDER BY ranked.depth ASC, d.path ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.document_id, d.project_id, d.path, d.language, c.chunk_type, c.symbol_name, c.business_summary, c.source_snippet, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'startLine')::int, 0) AS start_line, COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'endLine')::int, 0) AS end_line, 0 AS score, (1 - (c.embedding_vec <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector))) AS similarity FROM ai_code_chunk c JOIN ai_code_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.project_id IN #{pid} AND c.source_snippet IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_vec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.embedding_vec <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector), c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
